description: perform_request and perform_follow_redirect both call Crest::Request.execute with the same option list. Extract a private execute_crest_request(method, url, headers) helper to remove the duplication. Rename handle_redirects → follow_redirect_chain for clarity. The perform_request method currently mixes SSRF check, semaphore, circuit breaker, rate limiter, DNS rebinding, request, redirect handling, size check, and circuit breaker recording — too many responsibilities. Extract a small set of helpers without changing public behavior.
title: Extract redirect chain and Crest execution into private methods
